issues.explanation:
Special characters are unsupported by Hugo slugify and may cause
shell escaping issues.

Current:  config@v2.md
Suggested: configv2.md

Allowed characters: [a-z0-9-_.]
Invalid characters found: @
issues.fix: Rename to remove special characters: configv2.md

issues.message: Body begins with a top-level H1
issues.explanation: The page's H1 is rendered from the `title` frontmatter field. A body H1 duplicates the rendered heading and confuses the reader (which title is the real one?). Start the body with H2 or deeper.
issues.fix: Remove the `# Title` line from the body, or change it to `## Title`.
